content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves a challenge against Matthew 1:20 after noting the challenger's chain is footed, so it is doing the chain-versus-link evaluation K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- the challenger's covenant-origin analogy is footed (1 Chronicles 28:6, Acts 1:8) but the sentence's own words state the source of what is in the womb; answered in [CR3] LINK 2.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"never verse by verse: one reading lets a single verse's own words counter a footed pressed chain; the other requires weighing the whole pressed chain against the opposing chain by footing and not letting one verse decide alone.","why":"The judge notes the challenger's chain is footed but then uses the sentence's own words to resolve the challenge, which is verse-level decision rather than chain-against-chain footing required by K-C."}
